title: Last Man Standing
description: This is a new investment idea which is more of an experiment on the human psyche, we wanted to see how investors would react to our mechanism of infinite buy pressure because of FOMO and greed
how_its_made:
We ran into a lot of challenges while building the project, a few are listed below :

We tried calling functions of other contracts from out contract but then figured out that only the logic is passed while calling functions from other contracts and no data.

Balances and Reward calculation had a lot of problems because we are taking a tax on all transactions and small amounts of tokens are always left behind which have to be taken into account otherwise, over time a lot of money will be lost.

Testing the contract was a challenge as both of us are not auditors, but with the use of open source smart contract testing platforms and looking through the code hundreds of times makes us sure that the code is bug free.
